messages:
Priya: Quick heads-up — we need to stamp the staging base image with an attestation signed by the KMS key before the rebase next Wednesday. Need a short RBAC plan + audit logging checklist. Any blockers?
Devon: ack. Can you confirm which key URI we're using and which principal needs signing perms?
Priya: Using the org KMS key: kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/image-signer. Principal is the image-builder SA (image-builder@redwood-prod.svc). We want least-priv: only sign, no key management.
Alex: For GCP that would be IAM binding like `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` or the narrower `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`? I think signerVerifier is right for cosign-backed attestation.
Sam: Vulnerability triage note: the latest scan flagged glibc CVE-2024-XXXXX in one layer. If we rebuild now we'll pick the patched base. Is it safe to accelerate the schedule?
Priya: If rebuild picks patched packages automatically, yes. We still want a canary image and prod hold for 48h.
Julia: Quick snippet I used for cosign -> KMS signing. Drop into CI job:

```
# sign image with cosign using KMS key
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key "kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/image-signer" gcr.io/redwood/staging-base:20260401
```

Also, CI role needs `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` on the key and `roles/storage.objectViewer` on the image bucket for pulling to sign.
Devon: +1. Also make sure the builder SA does NOT have list/delete key perms. We'll add a tight IAM binding scoped to the single key.
ci-bot: build queued for gcr.io/redwood/staging-base:20260401 — job id 8472.
ci-bot: build succeeded (7m) — pushed to staging tag.
Sam: After the signed push, I'll run the vuln scan and post a short diff of changed packages. If any criticals remain, we'll hold.
oncall-sre: If a CVE causes emergency rollback, how do we revoke the signed attestation? We can't revoke image signatures; need revoke path for the key and a runtime deny policy.
Priya: Good q — plan: 1) keep key rotation schedule and expose key status in console; 2) runtime: runtime policy will reject images not on the allowlist in the registry manifest (we'll update allowlist per rollout); 3) fallback: if key compromise suspected, rotate key and mark old images as untrusted in the allowlist.
Alex: For audit logging: enable KMS Admin audit logs + Storage Admin data access for writes on the bucket and push KMS log sinks to the security project. Retention 365d for now.
Julia: Also add a small test in canary pipeline: verify cosign signature, verify attestation payload (build_id, git_sha, build_image_id) before promoting. Example: `cosign verify --key ... gcr.io/...`
Devon: I can prepare the minimal IAM terraform change (binding to single key) and a short runbook for the SRE oncall for revocation steps.
Priya: Action items:
- Devon: terraform IAM binding + PR (due EOD today)
- Julia: add cosign verify step to canary pipeline (PR by tomorrow)
- Sam: vuln diff after scan (post here)
- Alex: confirm audit sinks & retention and post elasticsearch index name for alerts
- oncall-sre: sanity-check rollback steps and runtime deny semantics

Thanks all — let's reconvene if Sam finds anything critical. :handshake:
